assumptions: Install pack with key and PCB absent; insert key after pack.
Axis-aligned maximum pack rectangle and exact nominal key boxes; no tilting or cell bending.
No wire, housing, hand/tool clearance, manufacturing tolerance or pack swelling included.
Full assembly and key retention remain unqualified.
PCB sweep uses rectangular component envelopes and nominal Z;0.2mm XY expansion is a sensitivity allowance, not measured placement or printing tolerance.
Mated battery housing, wire and thermal pad handling are omitted; populated-board clearance alone does not prove full assembly.

Y/Z key offsets are assembly alignment sensitivities, not printer dimensional tolerances. A nominally touching support has no positive insertion clearance at final PCB height. Raising both pack and PCB together preserves their relative geometry but still requires a support fixture and harness validation.

Alternative sequence is a rigid-body feasibility screen only: supporting fixture, connector mating access, final harness routing, thermal interface and outward key retention remain unresolved. Never suspend the battery by its wires.
alternative_assembly_sequence: Mate pack and PCB outside the case while independently supporting both; final relative positions must be maintained.
Lower pack and populated PCB together 14mm with key and lid absent. Existing individual sweeps against the body bound this rigid translation.
Keep pack and PCB together 0.4mm above their final seats on independent supports; insert left key horizontally at its nominal height, then lower the group 0.4mm onto supports.
Fit lid and qualified retention system only after harness and thermal interface placement are resolved.
